source.absorbed_from: directing-stickman-videos style-catalog Style 2B Modern Beanie Cinematic Story

lens_aspect.focal: 2D character in full-color cinematic environment, shallow depth feel
lens_aspect.notes: 全彩叙事环境 + 2D 角色

rules: 16:9: stage action across left, center, and right, lateral tracking, deliberate negative space
9:16: foreground/background depth, stacked motion, vertical reveals, foreground passes, interface-safe overlay space
subject centered in rich environmental framing
composition.zh: 横屏左右调度，竖屏纵深堆叠；环境框住主体

rules: atmospheric narrative mood (warm lamplight, dusk sky, golden clouds)
lighting.zh: 电影级体积光 + 柔景深 + 叙事氛围

rules: rich full-color cinematic environment with volumetric lighting and depth of field
figure wears bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and yellow t-shirt, black stick limbs and shorts
smooth 2D vector animation aesthetics for the character even within textured atmospheric background
maximum three saturated accent colors named with ordinary words
no technical color notation (hex, RGB, Pantone) in generation prompts
color.zh: 全彩环境 + 红帽黄衫火柴人，角色保持 2D 矢量质感

rules: character-driven physical actions inside rich environments: walking through a dimly lit cozy bedroom, running along a desert highway, climbing a mountain ridge
rapid scene changes, kinetic motion-graphic transformations, frequent visual events while preserving identical figure design and constant line weight
motion.zh: 角色在全彩环境中做物理动作，保持线稿一致

rhythm.cut_rule: one 10s clip = three timed beats [0-3s][3-7s][7-10s]; visual change every 2-3 seconds; never idle
rhythm.zh: 10 秒一段三节拍，每 2-3 秒有视觉变化

signature.en: rich full-color cinematic environment with volumetric lighting, soft depth of field, atmospheric narrative mood
signature.zh: 全彩电影环境 + 体积光 + 柔景深

signature.en: minimalist 2D animated stick figure wearing a bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and a yellow t-shirt, with simple black stick limbs and shorts
signature.zh: 红帽黄衫火柴人（无绒球）

signature.en: smooth 2D vector animation aesthetics for the character preserved even inside a textured atmospheric background
signature.zh: 角色保持 2D 矢量动画质感

negative: visible words, letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, interface copy, logos, watermarks

anime_safe.notes: 2D 线稿角色 + 全彩环境，与非写实画风兼容

rules: use foreground/background depth instead of left-right staging
stack motion vertically; reveal downward or upward
keep overlay text in the interface-safe upper/lower band
switch the composition axis to the vertical center line
vertical_9x16.note: 竖屏必须重构构图而非改比例标签

grade.description: warm cinematic grade, soft contrast, gentle saturation

line_weight: simple black lines, uniform stroke, vibrant 2D animation
character_dna: A minimalist 2D animated stick figure wearing a bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and a yellow t-shirt, with simple black stick limbs and shorts. Simple black lines, vibrant colors, smooth 2D animation style.
